👋 Welcome The **ecotourism** package provides tools to analyze ecological observation data alongside weather conditions. This guide helps you get started with the package and links to detailed vignettes for different organisms and workflows.

**🧭 What You Can Do -- 🐾 Analyze observation records for various species**

-    📍 Identify top observation sites

-    🌦️ Integrate environmental data from nearby weather stations

-   🗺️ Visualize spatiotemporal patterns

**🧪 Organism-Specific Workflows**

Explore vignettes dedicated to individual species:

-   🔦 Glowworms Observations [➡️ Go to the vignette](../docs/articles/glowworms.html) 

-   🐦 Gouldian Finch Observations [➡️ Go to the vignette](../docs/articles/gouldian_finch.html)

-   🐠 Manta Rays Observations [➡️ Go to the vignette](../docs/articles/manta_rays.html)

-   🌸 Orchids Observations [➡️ Go to the vignette](../docs/articles/orchids.html)

Each includes:

-   Data cleaning and wrangling

-   Mapping and temporal summaries

-   Top station selection

**Merging with weather data**

🌤️ Weather Integration Combine ecological records with weather information:

-   📊 Weather Data Workflow: Join observations with weather from nearby stations.

-   🗺️ Weather Station Metadata: See available station coordinates and IDs.
